runs.selection: The initial requested live run is run-01; the follow-up requested three total, so two additional runs were made. No failed run was replaced or excluded.

static_input.scope: Web booking subsystem: public booking and management UI, web HTTP/tRPC booking and slot APIs, availability, booking lifecycle, persistence adapters, and supporting notification/calendar services. API v2, generic UI/auth utilities and provider-specific app-store implementations are outside this boundary. Supporting packages include their indexed files, not just booking-exclusive code.

authentication: Existing Pi login; no credentials published.
timing: Runner elapsed_seconds includes setup, generation and internal verification; separate verification and time between requests are excluded. No contiguous batch wall-time comparison is claimed.
cache: Fresh in-memory sessions; no compaction, cache warming or automatic provider retries. OS and provider caches were not reset; token cache reads are reported.
input_scope_note: The raw export maps 740 files. The snapshot has 738 files with structural nodes; packages/emails/docker-compose.yml and packages/prisma/docker-compose.yml have no nodes. All 11525 nodes are assigned exactly once.

publication.graphs_and_sidecars: Exact bytes; graph.json, membership.json, aggregation.json and tools.jsonl use lossless gzip.
publication.shared_inputs: Identical static-input.json and source-manifest.json are losslessly gzipped once; instructions.md and schema.json are exact bytes.
publication.run_records: Only run_directory is normalized to . and original_run_id added; original run.json hashes are in statistics.json.
publication.omitted: Source checkouts, model event streams, effective prompts with local cwd, subprocess server configuration and credentials remain local.
publication.test_logs: Local checkout paths normalized to <repo>; no test outcomes changed.
